hook.en: A family planning a wedding books the hall, the caterer and the band months in advance. Nobody calls it management, but that is planning, and every business does the same.
hook.kn: ಮದುವೆಗೆ ತಿಂಗಳುಗಟ್ಟಲೆ ಮೊದಲೇ ಸಭಾಂಗಣ, ಅಡುಗೆಯವರು, ವಾದ್ಯ ಗೊತ್ತುಪಡಿಸುತ್ತೇವೆ. ಅದೇ ಯೋಜನೆ; ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಂದು ವ್ಯವಹಾರವೂ ಹೀಗೆಯೇ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: Planning is deciding in advance what to do and how to do it. It is one of the basic managerial functions and it bridges the gap from where we are to where we want to be. It involves setting objectives and developing an appropriate course of action to achieve them.

points.en: Deciding in advance what and how
Bridges the gap between present and desired future

title.en: On the board: planning as a bridge

narration.en: Watch the board as we build this up step by step.

say.en: On the left is where we are today; on the right is where we want to be.
Planning is the bridge between the two.
It gives direction and reduces the risk of uncertainty.
It reduces overlapping and waste, and promotes new ideas.
It helps decision making and sets standards for controlling.

right.en: Everyone knows the shop aims at ₹50 lakh sales this year
Extra stock is planned in case the monsoon is late
Two departments no longer order the same supplies
Planning meetings bring up a home-delivery idea
Alternatives are weighed against the goal before choosing
The sales target becomes the yardstick for review

body.en: Planning provides directions, reduces the risk of uncertainty, reduces overlapping and wasteful activities, promotes innovative ideas, facilitates decision making, and establishes standards for controlling.

narration.en: Planning provides directions, reduces the risk of uncertainty, reduces overlapping and wasteful activities, promotes innovative ideas, facilitates decision making, and establishes standards for controlling.
narration.kn: ಯೋಜನೆ ದಿಕ್ಕು ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, ಅನಿಶ್ಚಿತತೆಯ ಅಪಾಯ ತಗ್ಗಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, ಅಪವ್ಯಯ ತಡೆಯುತ್ತದೆ, ಹೊಸ ಆಲೋಚನೆ ಉತ್ತೇಜಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, ನಿರ್ಧಾರಕ್ಕೆ ನೆರವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ ಮತ್ತು ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣಕ್ಕೆ ಮಾನದಂಡ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ.

problem.en: A Hassan coffee exporter fixes a target of exporting 500 tonnes this year, studies rainfall forecasts, books shipping in advance, and later compares actual exports with the target. Identify three points of importance of planning.

steps.en: The 500-tonne target gives everyone a clear direction: provides directions.
Studying rainfall and booking shipping early: reduces the risk of uncertainty.
Comparing actual exports with the target: establishes standards for controlling.

answer.en: Provides directions, reduces the risk of uncertainty, and establishes standards for controlling.
